{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to be safe
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the 'revenue' column for anomalies
revenue_counts = sales_df['revenue'].value_counts()
print(revenue_counts)

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any conversion issues
print(f"Number of NaN in revenue after conversion: {sales_df['revenue'].isna().sum()}")

# Check if any non-numeric values remain
print(f"Unique values in revenue after conversion: {sales_df['revenue'].unique()}")"}
